name: Xash3D-FWGS
long_description:
Port of Xash3D-FWGS for PSVITA.
Xash3D-FWGS is an open source re-creation of the GoldSrc engine, a modified Quake Engine running Half-Life, Counter Strike and Team Fortress.

NOTE: Data files are slightly different from vitaXash3D. This means both versions can't be installed at the same time.

Note: this download is hosted on an external server, not GitHub, and may stop working if that server goes down or changes without the catalog knowing.
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: PC
